notes: Crop rectangles measured after inspection, not equal-cell splitting. Crop units [x,y,width,height].
Transparent alpha preserved losslessly through WebP conversion.
Warm floor is quiet and repeatable visually, but mathematical edge seamlessness is not guaranteed.
Walls are isometric sprites with diagonal top edge; do not stretch into screen-horizontal architectural geometry.
No characters, NPCs, room backgrounds or collision geometry are baked into props.

promptSet.floor: Quiet warm beige/pale-gray limestone block floor; flat overhead, square fill, subtle contrast, no objects, paths, walls or text.
promptSet.props: Transparent 2-column 3-row sprite atlas of complete bookcase, family-friendly weapons rack, throne on limestone podium, dining table with benches, stove with pots, storage crates/barrels; soft painted 3D casual isometric castle materials, upper-left light.
promptSet.walls: Transparent atlas of complete broad straight limestone wall and separate limestone torch pillar; oblique top-down game camera, warm upper-left lighting.
